about: Momcozy makes products for moms and babies: pumps, nasal aspirators, baby monitors, white noise machines, air purifiers. A consumer brand, not a nonprofit. About three years with us. Briefs come from Peter Jin (US baby care) and Jolie Chen (US). Our lead: Atdhe, who also shot this batch himself on an iPhone.

Goals & Preferences
_Built 2026-07-04 by typo-qa (third-pillar standing order) from the intake form, Editing preferences, and market rules already in this file. Update dated lines as new goals land._

- **North-star story angle:** authentic UGC mom-life moments that build **emotional resonance** - "be the brand side that understands users" (intake form). Relatable everyday scenes (working from home with baby, night feeds, dog-walk rounds) beat polished ad-speak; the product sits naturally IN the moment, never demo-first.
- **Product presence:** a Momcozy product appears organically in-scene (highchair, Air One, bottle warmer-¦); visible logo is a plus, hard-sell voiceover is not the format. Product overlay terms per the Typo-QA Glossary.
- **Market localization is non-negotiable:** DE / US / FR lanes never cross-pollinate footage, talent, or settings (authenticity - see "Notes for future work"). German cuts = German talent, German homes, German captions ("brick style" blended with local lifestyle/trends).
- **Tone/format prefs:** UGC / street-interview / scripted-actress lanes per campaign; burned-in bubble-style captions; campaign taglines verbatim per glossary ("The Smallest Big Win.", closing slogan "Choose you, too").
- **NO TALKING-HEAD-ONLY VIDEOS (client directive, 2026-09-16, Peter Jin):** Momcozy senior management will no longer publish videos that consist mainly of someone talking directly to camera, on the grounds that long-form talking-head does not drive sales. Replacement format he named: UGC with dynamic scene transitions, fast-paced editing, and natural product integration. Applies going forward to every brief and cut.
- **Hard rules:** canonical spellings per the Typo-QA Glossary (Momcozy one word, capital M; product names title-case). No re-use of US assets on the DE feed.


## Organization Overview
Momcozy is a consumer brand (NOT a nonprofit) that makes products for mothers of infants and young children. Their tagline: "Cozy Designs Born from Love." Founded by Athena, who dedicated herself to solving problems mothers faced - starting with optimizing breast pumping technology for the lifestyle of being a parent. Products include breast pumps, nursing bras, belly bands, nasal aspirators, baby swings, air purifiers, baby monitors, bottle washers, and more. They partner with Happy Productions for UGC-style promotional content.

**Website**: momcozy.com
**Social**: IG @momcozy | TikTok @momcozy / @momcozyofficial


## Editing preferences

- **Baby on camera is a hard client rule on every non-street-interview video (Peter Jin, Slack DM to Atdhe, 2026-09-22 22:49 ET, verbatim):** *"except for street interview videos, all other videos must include the baby on camera. When showing the product being used for baby care, please make sure it is used correctly according to the product's intended usage."* Street-interview cuts are exempt by its own terms; every other deliverable is in scope, and the correct-usage half applies to every product demo. Source: slack:D0657U97B4P:1790131783.085619. Folded into all 12 in-scope Post Production briefs on 2026-09-27 (Kight V1-V4 13141749165 / 12850328707 / 13141769508 / 13141754076; Holly 13103317248 / 13103225532 / 13103225202; Sept US Babycare 13010216158 / 13010214388 / 13010186229 / 13010215547 / 12850328094); exempt street-interview items 13010215284 and 12850318277 deliberately untouched.
- **Aspirator usage sequence is a hard product rule (restated 3x by client, July brief):** mist spray FIRST to soften nasal mucus, suction SECOND to remove. Mist is for the nose only — never the mouth. Show the product fully assembled when demonstrating assembly.
- **Talking-head as a sole format is retired (2026-09-16).** Client definition: "videos that mainly consist of someone talking directly to the camera." Preferred instead: dynamic scene transitions, fast-paced editing, natural product integration. Reference cuts supplied by the client: board item 12869415843 (BM08 - 1 Video) and Frame.io share c75044ea-747e-45e6-8827-b782b883d22c.
- **"Brick style" blended with local lifestyle/trends** - DE market specifically.
- **UGC / street interview format** - man-on-street is a recurring HP motif for Momcozy (NYC shoots Oct 2025; "with babies" Mar 2026).
- **Scripted actress shoots** - Mother's Day campaign (Apr 2026) uses 1-2 actresses with babies; multi-location (courthouse, office, hospital-room set); 4 scripts to be approved.
- **Educational + product ads** alongside TikTok/UGC.
- **Market-specific adaptations:** Germany, US, France - separate scripts, separate talent, localized settings. Must not reuse US assets for DE feed (authenticity).
- **Baby/maternity product expertise:** Talent must be comfortable with product demos (bottle washer, nursing bras, breast pumps).
